We have mass spectrum data with m/z values and intensities. Need to identify elements definitively based on isotope distribution patterns visible. We need to look at isotopic peaks: likely the pattern of isotopes for elements like C (13C), N (15N), O (17O,18O), S (34S,33S), Cl (35Cl,37Cl), Br (79Br,81Br). The spectrum shows peaks at 211.0764 (base), then 212.0796 (+1.0032), 213.0737 (+2.0 approx?), 213.0838 (+2.0074?), 214.0768 (+3.0004?), 215.0794 (+4.0030?), etc. Need to deduce which elements cause these isotopic patterns.

We need to retrieve isotopic distribution of common elements to compare. Use retrieve_isotope_distribution tool.
